# What of the arrangements of the 傳 is a law

<!-- Generated by tools/research/registry.py; edit the matching JSON record. -->

`hexagram-arrangements-and-laws` · **recorded-checked** · theorem · F01 · [record](hexagram-arrangements-and-laws.json) · [register](../../../../RESULTS.md)

> A law runs the received order only as a table: it reads every line for every line and keeps no symmetry. 卦變 is a step of the law of exchange between the trigrams; the parity of the count, not the count, is a lumping the laws go alike across; the 雜卦 keeps the pairs; waxing and waning never rests.

<a id="laws--规律"></a>
## Laws

1. Configurations are made from their lines and are equal where their lines are; the complement and the change of a line act line by line, and a change moves every configuration. A property holding at every member of the received order holds of every configuration, which is how the finite laws are checked. (`Becoming.Hexagram.ofLines`, `Becoming.Hexagram.ofLines_line`, `Becoming.Hexagram.ext_lines`, `Becoming.Hexagram.line_complement`, `Becoming.Hexagram.line_flip_self`, `Becoming.Hexagram.flip_moves`, `Becoming.Hexagram.allOf`, `Becoming.Hexagram.of_allOf`, `Becoming.Hexagram.every_of_order`, `Becoming.Hexagram.differs_ne`)
2. A law runs a list where its run from the first member holds the list in order, exactly where it takes each member to the next; the steps of a list, membership by position and a decision of the check are read off the list. (`Becoming.Hexagram.steps`, `Becoming.Hexagram.Follows`, `Becoming.Law.memberAt`, `Becoming.Hexagram.RunsThrough`, `Becoming.Hexagram.Follows.head`, `Becoming.Hexagram.Follows.tail`, `Becoming.Hexagram.memberAt_default`, `Becoming.Hexagram.runsThrough_iff`, `Becoming.Hexagram.followsb`, `Becoming.Hexagram.of_followsb`, `Becoming.Hexagram.memberAt_of_mem`, `Becoming.Hexagram.anyStep`, `Becoming.Hexagram.anyStep_sound`)
3. A law runs the received order: the one taking each to the next and 未濟 back to 乾. Every law running the order agrees with it everywhere but at 未濟; exactly the one closing 未濟 to 乾 merges nothing, and its one orbit holds all sixty-four, first returning at the sixty-fourth step. 4. Every law running the order reads every line for every line, so no reading blind to one line fixes any line of the next and no three-cell rule on a ring of six, with the wrap straight or turned, runs it, waxing and waning among them; 剝 to 復 is one step of the straight shift. 5. A law commuting with an exchange it steps along goes back the next step, so no law running the order commutes with 錯, 綜 or both; every rearrangement of places with a mask commutes with 錯 and none runs the order; a law running it goes alike neither across the pairs of complements nor across the parity. 6. Exchanging two lines keeps the count of unbroken lines; an exchange across the trigrams is a step of the law of exchange between them, passing one unbroken line up, down or nothing; 損, 益, 恒 and 咸 are 泰 and 否 with a lower and an upper line exchanged. <a id="conditions--条件"></a>
## Conditions

- No axiom and no premise: the runs of a list, the order's laws, the exchange of two lines, the parity, the 雜卦's list, the stations and 交 are defined in the module; each spine law is used at its stated hypotheses (Law.Commutes.paired_halfway with an exchange that is its own inverse; World.balances_iff_exchange on the world a course of exchanges reads; Learning.goAlike_iff_lumped at the parity); the laws along runs hold for every run of the named process. The finite facts are checked by evaluation over the sixty-four configurations or the eight trigrams.

<a id="does-not-show--未表明"></a>
## Does not show

- What any passage says beyond these laws; the passage maps of the chapters on the 易传 and on the Chinese sources state, passage by passage, agreement, exact scope or divergence, and their readings are the AI's. The 雜卦's sequence is checked against the preserved text by verify_mapping.py, not by the Lean.
- The 序卦's and 雜卦's reasons between pairs; which exchange the 彖 means for a configuration it names, and the later 卦變 schemes (not preserved here); the seasons and directions of the stations; the best partial agreements of local rules and rearrangements with the order and the stations (9 and 28 of 63, 5 and 4 of 8), which stay script computations.
- That 交 is better than 不交, 損 worse than 益, or that the order, the exchange or the parity supports 生生; the module has no ethical predicate and no judgment.
- **Counterexample:** The claim that the received order is not the orbit of any law (in the open items of the chapter on the 易传 before this record) is false as stated: the law taking each to the next runs it, with one orbit of sixty-four (orderNext_runsOrder, orderNext_one_orbit). What holds is that no law reading less than the whole configuration, or keeping a symmetry, runs it. [source](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/HexagramSequences.lean)

**Standard boundaries:** No ethical premise and no Lean axiom is used. · Contains no ethical predicate and evaluates neither arising nor ceasing. · Stated for discrete steps. · A law of the formal model; its correspondence to actual systems is a separate obligation. · Names follow the structural naming criteria and are adopted only where the statement has their exact meaning; readings are interpretations, open to revision. · A relation omitted by a weaker description does not refute the fuller account.

<a id="correspondence--对应"></a>
### Correspondence

Closes the seventh gap the record chinese-sources-on-the-spine found (the hexagram world's supplements) and the open item of hexagrams-on-the-spine on the order's reasons, so far as a law reaches them. 11 passages cite this module (6 agreements, 3 exact scopes, 2 divergences): 2 in the 易传 chapter's map, 9 in the Chinese sources' map. Reading (the AI's, D55): the 序卦's reasons between pairs are words added to a list, not a law the configurations carry; 卦變 is one exchange read from two ends; 陽卦奇 is the parity, which carries the law where the count does not; 交 reads a direction into the two values.
